newsitem.title: UK: NatWest names new chief finance officer.
newsitem.headline: NatWest names new chief finance officer.

text.p: National Westminster Bank Plc said it has appointed Richard Delbridge as a director and chief financial officer with effect from October 1.
Delbridge was group finance director of HSBC Holdings Plc until late last year, having joined Midland Bank as finance director in 1989.
Previously, Delbridge had worked as general manager for the UK of J.P. Morgan and was formerly a partner of accountancy firm Arthur Andersen & Co.
Last month, NatWest announced that its previous chief financial officer Richard Goeltz was joining American Express as vice chairman and chief financial officer.
